author: Mlevif
quote:
I've been playing GTA since 1997, starting with the original Grand Theft Auto on PlayStation. Then, in 1999, I got GTA 2. I absolutely loved those games.

When GTA III came out, I was excited. It was a completely new experience, this time in 3D, but it remained faithful to the spirit of its predecessors. Vice City was another incredible game, and I have amazing memories of playing it. It introduced things we couldn't even have imagined back then. It was always like that. 

Fast-forward to GTA VI, and I feel like the game is actively trying to destroy every good memory I have of GTA. 

Those responsible for taking this franchise in this direction must be identified and held accountable. They should be fired.

You know how Joker was an amazing movie and then they came up with Joker the musical? That's how bad this game is.
